summary: The First Den is a quiet first-person 3D home above a teal lake: a three-room timber-and-plaster den, rotated two-room wing, terrace, garden and generated wooded valley. One live place is wired through world/place config; reusable templates and generators build the home, furnishings, devices, window gardens and awaiting gateway, while focused scripts own movement, interaction, solar time, weather, ambience, lighting and the radio.
places: places/main - the only live place; config owns spawn, gravity, native sky/time cycle, terrain materials, lake/path/gateway marks and procedural meadow/forest decoration
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - live home cell with the den, rotated wing, terrace, garden, furnishings, clock/radio, sconces, weather root, six window gardens and uphill portal
places/main/cells/objects.scene - supplemental authored home floor/foundation pieces, stool blanket and portal lantern light children
places/main/cells/x-1z-2.scene through x3z-1.scene - authored remote chalk outcrops and sparse fir/pine framing across the lake view
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry for The First Den; wires main, player, camera, lighting, UI, inputs, networking and arrival behavior
templates/player.js#player - character body root with player movement, humanoid gait and home-feel behaviors
templates/camera.js#camera - custom first-person camera root using engine look orientation
places/main/config.yaml - place runtime root for spawn, gravity, sky/time, terrain, water/path marks and decoration layers
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#home-root - home placement root; children hold the den, wing, terrace, garden, furniture and devices
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#home-weather-controller - place-local runtime root for solar synchronization, weather, rain/night ambience, fireflies and practical lights
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#home-window-garden - root for six facade-relative window compositions and terrain-grounded garden children
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#home-portal - authored first-destination gateway root; owns portal children, empty link, phase and invitation state
shared: scripts/lib/data/home.js - canonical HOME placement contract: floorY 24, groundY 23.55, den polygon, rotated wing coordinates and spawn
scripts/gen/home-architecture-data.js - shared architectural plan, room polygons, wall/opening definitions, roof planes and DOORS consumed by architecture generators
scripts/lib/data/home-portal.js + scripts/lib/portal-path.js + home-portal-stonework.js - canonical gateway position, route, arch/landing/stonework, prompt and chime contract
scripts/lib/data/den-blanket.js - canonical stool-blanket profile, attachment, thickness, hem and ripple tuning consumed by den-blanket
scripts/lib/data/player.yml + camera.yml - movement/gait tuning and camera eye-height data consumed by player, locomotion and camera
scripts/lib/data/home-feel.js - interaction reach, door tolerances, step sounds and hearth/outdoor audio tuning reused by door, player-feel and ambience
scripts/lib/data/hillside.js + window-garden.js + home-day/home-weather/home-lamplight data - shared authored sites and solar/weather/light definitions
scripts/lib/data/radio-library.js + radio-program.js + radio-panel.js - shared station/song/report registry, programme timing and recessed face UI consumed by home-radio and home-devices
notableExports: scripts/player.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - export player movement/avatar setup and humanoid yaw/gait behavior; locomotion also exports sit
scripts/camera.js - exports finiteNumber and update for first-person eye placement and local-player hiding
scripts/den-terrain.js - exports VALLEY, heightAt and materialAt for the lake valley heightmap and material bands
scripts/gen/home-architecture-data.js - exports ARCH, ROOMS, WALLS, wall, planPoint, wingPoint, roof helpers and DOORS
scripts/gen/den-furniture.js + scripts/gen/den-blanket.js - export furniture geometry/collider/editor plus blanketPoint, blanketGrid and blanket geometry
scripts/gen/home-portal-path.js + home-portal-stonework.js + home-portal-veil.js - export path, landing/arch/lantern and transparent veil geometry/colliders
scripts/lib/portal-path.js - exports pathSamples and pathFrame for the shared ground-following gateway route
scripts/home-radio.js - exports stationAt, songsAt, songAt, beginMusic, fadeForReport and retireRadioBroadcast for persistent radio programming and migration
ownership: world.config.yaml - owns world identity, default place, networking, input actions/axes/touch bindings, player/camera/template wiring, lighting, UI and arrival hook

places/main/config.yaml - owns static place spawn/terrain/native atmosphere setup, solar cycle anchor, wind-enabled decoration and gateway pad/clear/path marks; grass now remains around the house except marked clear paths/landing
scripts/lib/data/home-day.js + home-weather.js - own solar timing/phase rules and weather phase definitions, targets, sounds and firefly sites
scripts/lib/data/home.js + scripts/gen/home-architecture-data.js - own canonical home coordinates, room plan, openings, roof/wall definitions, door constants and architectural values used by builders
scripts/lib/data/home-portal.js + home-portal-stonework.js + portal-path.js - own portal coordinates, route, arch/paving/stonework/planting settings and prompt/chime constants
places/main/cells/*.scene - own live placement ids, parents, transforms, authored state, seeds and physics, including door links/state, portal link/phase, invitation, gateway children and lights

templates/home-architecture.js, home-garden.js, den-furniture.js, home-devices.js, home-sconce.js, home-door-label.js and home-portal-* - own reusable object defaults, tags, blueprint metadata and child lights/UI

scripts/home-radio.js - owns radio powered/station/songIndices/guest song/programme phase, playhead, forecast interruption/resume and positional self.audio; radio-library/program/panel and device template supply shared content/defaults/UI
flows: moveX/moveZ + camera aim input -> scripts/player.js onInput -> per-body session moveIntent -> update writes velocity/jump -> character controller applies place gravity
move/look input -> scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js onInput -> gait targetYaw/turning scratch -> update writes body yaw and Idle/Walk/Run channels; parent attachment switches to sit/feet-IK
templates/camera.js target body -> scripts/camera.js update -> camera feetPosition at scaled eye height, view rotation and local-player hiding

interact input -> scripts/home-player-feel.js onInput -> scripts/lib/home-interaction.js nearestInteractable -> press to the interactable within reach that the camera looks at most squarely (a door hinge, the spatial radio, a game box)
door prompt ui:use -> scripts/home-door-label.js -> press to hinge state -> scripts/home-door.js toggles the leaf and refreshes both sides' Open/Close verbs

door onSpawn/update or press -> scripts/home-door.js syncDoorCollision -> leaf has no physics while moving/open; closed kinematic collider returns only when fully shut and no player occupies its bounds

radio press or face ui:power/ui:tune/ui:next -> scripts/home-radio.js -> powered/station/songIndices state -> syncProgramAudio writes the radio's positional self.audio and radio-panel reads station/song/phase fields

radio update -> home-radio forecast reads place.state.weather.nextAt -> fadeForReport plays the alternating measured local bulletin before rain, then resumeMusic restores the interrupted song playhead; gaps and fuzz advance the programme
places/main/config.yaml terrain.generator -> scripts/den-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt -> engine heightmap, terrain material weights and sea mark produce ledge, valley, lake and ridges

places/main/config.yaml decoration layers -> valley-meadow/valley-tree generators; scene hillside rows -> home-garden generators -> close grass, forest scatter and authored planted groves with shared wind

home-window-garden root + scripts/lib/data/window-garden.js -> home-garden rock/planting/birch generator bindings -> six facade-relative low compositions grounded to terrain without blocking lake, terrace, path or door routes

home-weather-controller update -> syncDay/weatherAt -> atmosphere, place.state.weather, rain/night/firefly objects and syncLamplight; home-portal approach/passage -> home-portal.js -> local chime, refusal toast or ctx.cross for a nonempty link
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/home-architecture-*.js + home-architecture-kit.js - reused across the den and rotated wing foundations, floors, plaster walls, timber joinery, fitted glazing, doors, roofs, trim and chimney; varied by room/run/frame/facet

scripts/gen/home-garden-*.js + home-garden-kit.js + hillside.js + window-garden.js - shared terrace, path, birch, rock, planting, fern, pebbles, lantern and six window-garden family; varied by site geometry, group, species and seed

scripts/gen/den-furniture.js + den-furniture-mesh.js + den-blanket.js + templates/den-furniture.js - one parameterized furniture family for table, chairs, shelves, hearth, pendants, rug, stool, blanket, boxes and star

scripts/gen/valley-meadow.js, valley-tree.js, valley-outcrop.js and valley-mesh.js - shared valley decoration/outcrop family across close grass, forest scatter and authored chalk ledges; varied by params, cell recipe and seed
scripts/player.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - reusable character movement/gait pair on the player template, varied by player.yml tuning, input and body state

scripts/home-weather.js + home-day.js + home-lamplight.js + effects-den-rain.fx.js/effects-den-fireflies.fx.js + templates/home-atmosphere.js + scripts/lighting.js - reusable solar/weather/ambience and practical-light family, varied by hour, rain and site

scripts/gen/home-portal-path.js + home-portal-stonework.js + home-portal-veil.js + templates/home-portal-* + home-portal.js - one waiting-gateway family combining route, hand-cut arch, veil, prompt and trigger behavior

scripts/home-radio.js + radio-library.js + radio-program.js + radio-panel.js + templates/home-devices.js - one persistent spatial-radio family with two five-song stations, a rare guest song, gaps/fuzz and rain forecasts; varied by station, track and programme phase
migrationNotes: Preserve the shared HOME contract when editing: finished indoor floors are Y=24, prepared ground is 23.55, plan coordinates map through root (-3,24,-3), and the wing is the whole 45-degree rotated u/v frame.

Architecture, glazing, garden and portal geometry are live imports of canonical data; change home.js, home-architecture-data.js, home-glazing.js, window-garden.js or home-portal*.js together with affected scene/config state, not by hand-moving only one child.

home-root still carries state.build: in progress even though home-architecture-work reports shellReady and the placed build is substantially complete; treat that authored status as a known inconsistency before exposing build-progress UI.

Preserve the solar epoch and current hour on migration: the cycle is 2 real hours with 90 minutes of day and 30 of night, while weather remains an independent 11-minute sequence and rain stays outside the roof footprint.

The radio is now a single spatial emitter with gain .24, reference distance 8m and silence at 22m; preserve powered/station/programme state, measured song/report durations and retire only the old station broadcast layer during migration.

The gateway (home-portal) is the door to the owner's first game: its state.link is empty until they name a game, then holds that world's address; keep its invitation range and route clearances. Door leaves shed physics while moving/open, and grass should meet the house except where explicit path/landing clear marks remain.
